title: Pursuant to the provisions of Sections 17 and 17A of Chapter 25 of the General Laws, the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes an assessment on the Intra-state revenues of Electric Companies to restore the Special Assessment Fund to $500,000 by making an estimate for the Fiscal Year 1998 and adjusting the 1997 estimate to the actual amount expended.
filings: AA ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Besser, Patrone, 97-64 AA DPU
Order Issued, Special Fund Assessment for Fiscal Year 1998. Commissioners: Howe, Besser DPU 97-64A
